scope: Heterogeneous single-sheet Select cohorts across all fifteen source _SheetItem kinds; existing painter/handles retained. Profiles semantic box ownership only; full profile painter remains explicit separate scope.

source_laws.selection: Ctrl press toggle/swallow; empty press retains cohort until release; window contains source boundingRect, crossing intersects; Ctrl add, Shift toggle, Ctrl+Shift remove. Locked/hidden cannot canvas-acquire; explicit Items selection separate.
source_laws.panel: Retain shown model while member; propagate changed fields to same concrete source model type only, one CompoundCommand/coalesced signature.
source_laws.move: Each member source own snap/anchor law; source press snapshot and single Compound geometry release. Capture actual callback exceptions; do not fake successful source history.
source_laws.delete: Real Delete focus excludes editor; compound remove, Undo appends per-family restored model and retains UUID identities.
source_laws.raw: Native unknown leaves separately protected; original known model equality remains literal.
